page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single main column, with a narrow marginal note column on the right. The top right carries the page number 115. The running head runs across the top of the text. The catchword and signature stand at the foot. Fragments at the far left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: millia Martyrum in Ecclesia Natalem Christi celebrantium igne iniecto con-cremati, holocaustum Deo offerebantur; inter hos emicuerunt,

Augusta Diocletiani coniux, cuius nomen ideo Paganorum Historiis suppressum & obliteratum auguror; Marcus item & Marcellianus, Nicostratus, Claudius, Castorius, Chromatius, Caius Gabinius, Dorotheus, cum suis sodalibus Gorgonio, & Migdonio, quos amplissimos in Aula honoris fuisse adeptos, & summa apud Caesarem gratia valuisse testatur Eusebius reliquique omnes, vel Natalium claritate, vel necessi-tudine & affinitate cum ipso Imperatore: vel denique Magistratibus & Prae-fecturis, sive in Vrbe, sive in Exercitu per insignes. In quo memorabile quidem est illud exemplum Niceph. Lib.7. cap.15. k Thebeae Legi-onis, quae tota fuit Christiana, nume-ro continens sex mille sexaginta sex, milites veteranos, validos animis, & armis instructos; hos sub lustrationis & iuramenti praetextu ad Idololatriam

page.notes: The marginal note mark in the right column is small and uncertain; it is read here as "k" and may be a different mark (marked [?] in the text would apply). The "!" between "Magistratibus" and "&" appears to be a stray printed mark and is omitted. The "k" in the text is set as a superscript-style letter. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
